claims.statement: Kit v2 rectangular MZI synthesis reconstructs random unitaries for N = 2 to 9 with spectral error below 1e-12.
claims.falsifier: Any N from 2 to 9 with reconstruction error of at least 1e-12 in agentkit.test_v2.MeshTests.
claims.limitations: Ideal transfer algebra only; no geometry, loss or fabrication error.
claims.next_action: Run agentkit.test_v2 in the project environment, keep the run log and attach it as software_test evidence.

claims.statement: A multilayer 3D network written by fs laser in glass is new.
claims.falsifier: A published prior fs-written multilayer 3D photonic network in glass.
claims.withdrawal_reason: Cao et al., Nat. Commun. 17, 5476 (2026), DOI 10.1038/s41467-026-72316-9: 8-layer fs-written network in borosilicate glass.
claims.next_action: Evaluate the narrower variant: silica, multi-face writing with measured registration (T09, T19).

claims.statement: A trench waveguide (core n = 1.444, trench delta n = -0.005, t = 12 um, a = 6 um), written by fs laser in silica, has a total propagation loss <= 0.3 dB/cm at 1550 nm.
claims.falsifier: Lower bound of the 95% CI above 0.3 dB/cm (registered F1). Separately, an upper bound below the leakage recomputed for the measured profile signals a model or measurement error.
claims.limitations: Mode, excitation and the single decision rule are not yet declared; the 0.3 dB/cm threshold is far above the 0.07 dB/cm reported at 1550 nm in fused silica (Tan et al., Opt. Lett. 47, 4766, 2022).
claims.next_action: Dated amendment before measuring (NOVEDAD-ESTADO section 5, points i to v), then T26 threshold review.

claims.statement: 8-bit recalibration meets C3 in the preregistered realization and in 28 of 36 realizations (78 %, exact 95% CI 0.61 to 0.90).
claims.falsifier: Recomputation from the retained realizations disagrees, or C2 remains failed.
claims.limitations: C2 fails (1.3e-2 to 1.7e-2 against 5e-3); delta is a model value, not measured (T14).
claims.next_action: Keep the C2 failure visible; measure delta (T14) before any yield claim.

claims.statement: Network F3-b meets H-F1 and H-F2.
claims.falsifier: Registered criteria H-F1 or H-F2 not met.
claims.limitations: Majority-class baseline is 52.5 % on the imbalanced test set; the electronic reference did not converge.
claims.next_action: New registered experiment with converged, gain-matched baselines and balanced metrics (T12, T16).
